🟢 accuracy hit and ratio ≤ 0.6x · 🟠 accuracy hit and 0.6x < ratio ≤ 1.2x · 🔴 accuracy missed or ratio > 1.2x · ⚪ not a speed comparison (arms not timed in one job, or a wall is missing). Accuracy hit: relax inside or above the RELION band by the row's metric (Quality column). Multi-seed rows: every relax seed inside or above the across-seed RELION band (all RELION runs of all seeds), and relax not below its same-seed RELION run on a majority of seeds; the Quality column shows the worst per-seed gap to the same-seed RELION run.

Resolution (Å) reads unmasked / masked; **a** unmasked half-map FSC, first three-shell-sustained crossing below 1/7; **b** unmasked half-map FSC 0.143 of the final unfiltered half maps; **c** relion_postprocess unmasked FSC 0.143 of the final half maps; **d** the engine's own last-iteration estimate (for Class3D not a gold-standard FSC); **f** InitialModel: FSC 0.5 of the registered final map against the reference (K>1: most populated class). Ratio: relax wall / RELION wall (fastest RELION configuration on the same hardware). Definitions, matching, GPUs and per-row notes: [provenance](relion_vs_relax_provenance.md) (updated 2026-09-25).
